name: Cursor
title: Ninebrains vs Cursor
description: Ninebrains vs Cursor: an agentic code editor with cloud agents and Bugbot reviews, compared with an open-source workbench for parallel Claude Code and Codex agents.
summary: Full AI editor with worktrees, cloud agents and Bugbot reviews. Paid tiers.
answer: Cursor is an AI code editor whose Agent can run in parallel git worktrees or in cloud VMs, with Bugbot reviewing pull requests. Ninebrains is not an editor: it runs the Claude Code and Codex CLIs you already use in parallel lanes. Choose Cursor for the best integrated editing loop; choose Ninebrains for an open-source, local job graph with checks that block completion.

what.text: An AI code editor. Agent completes coding tasks, runs terminal commands and edits code.

price.text: A free tier with limited agent requests. Cloud agents and Bugbot code reviews are on higher paid plans.

agents.text: Cursor’s own Agent, with a choice of frontier models.

isolation.text: Local git worktrees per task, or cloud agents in isolated VMs.

planning.text: Plan Mode writes an implementation plan before code; for larger work a coordinator agent delegates to other agents.

verification.text: Bugbot reviews pull requests for bugs and security issues, with Autofix. Cloud agents record screenshots, videos and logs of how they verified their work.

telemetry.text: Privacy Mode stops them training on your data. A general telemetry statement was not found.

chooseThem.text: One developer wants the best integrated editing loop: an editor and its agent in one product.
You want agents in cloud VMs that can drive a browser and desktop and keep running without your laptop.
You want managed pull-request review with automatic fixes.
You want to compare models on one task: /best-of-n runs it across models, each in its own worktree.

chooseUs: You already use Claude Code or Codex in a terminal and want to keep them, with your own subscription login.
You want open source and local-first, with no telemetry.
You want a dependency-aware job graph and completion blocked until configured checks pass, before a pull request exists.
limits: Ninebrains is not an editor replacement. It has a Monaco editor per lane, but you will likely keep your own editor alongside it.
